derivation: middle voice from a compound of G5384 (φίλος) and G5092 (τιμή);
def: to be fond of honor, i.e. emulous (eager or earnest to do something)

occurrences.text: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man’s foundation:
Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
